statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome

Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and optimize rate and rhythm control
The diagnoses addressed are I49.5 and I48.0
